description: Post-lowering AST conformance for grids/sectional_volume_1d/rules/growth_lr2m_tracer_D_bin_closed (see fixture.esm's description for what the expansion must contain). Every binding loads fixture.esm (NCELL=2, NBIN=4, NTRACER=2 bound at the import edges), runs the section-9.6.3 rewrite fixpoint, and must emit a byte-identical expanded AST in the esm-spec 9.6.4 reference-preserving form, with zero unlowered rewrite-target ops and zero surviving metaparameter names. The golden is generated by the Julia reference runner only (scripts/regenerate-goldens.sh) and compared bytewise by the other bindings.
